text_en: The Lord appeared to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat at the entrance of his tent in the heat of the day.
text_cn: 天正热的时候，亚巴郎坐在帐幕门口，上主在玛默勒橡树林那里，给他显现出来。

text_en: He looked up and saw three men standing near him. When he saw them, he ran from the tent entrance to meet them, and bowed down to the ground.
text_cn: 他举目一望，见有三人站在对面。他一见就由帐幕门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，

text_en: He said, “My lord, if I find favor with you, do not pass by your servant.
text_cn: 说：“我主如果我蒙你垂爱，请你不要由你仆人这里走过去，

text_en: Let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
text_cn: 我叫人拿点水来，洗洗你们的脚，然后在树下休息休息。

text_en: Let me bring a little bread, that you may refresh yourselves, and after that you may pass on—since you have come to your servant. ” So they said, “Do as you have said. ”
text_cn: 你们既然路过你仆人这里，等我拿点饼来，吃点点心，然后再走。”他们答说：“就照你所说的做吧！”

text_en: And Abraham hastened into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Make ready quickly three measures of choice flour, knead it, and make cakes. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎赶快进入帐幕，到撒辣前说：“你快拿三斗细面，和一和，作些饼。”

text_en: Abraham ran to the herd, and took a calf, tender and good, and gave it to the servant, who hastened to prepare it.
text_cn: 遂又跑到牛群中，选了一头又嫩又肥的牛犊，交给仆人，要他赶快煮好。

text_en: Then he took curds and milk and the calf that he had prepared, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree while they ate.
text_cn: 亚巴郎遂拿了凝乳和牛奶，及预备好了的牛犊，摆在他们面前；他们吃的时候，自己在树下侍候。

text_en: They said to him, “Where is your wife Sarah? ” And he said, “There, in the tent. ”
text_cn: 他们对他说：“你的妻子撒辣在哪里？”他答说：“在帐幕里。”

text_en: Then one said, “I will surely return to you in due season, and your wife Sarah shall have a son. ” And Sarah was listening at the tent entrance behind him.
text_cn: 其中一位说：“明年此时我必回到你这里，那时，你的妻子撒辣要有一个儿子。”撒辣其时正在那人背后的帐幕门口窃听。

text_en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
text_cn: 亚巴郎和撒辣都已年老，年纪很大，而且撒辣的月经早已停止。

text_en: So Sarah laughed to herself, saying, “After I have grown old, and my husband is old, shall I have pleasure? ”
text_cn: 撒辣遂心里窃笑说：“现在，我已衰老，同我年老的丈夫，还有这喜事吗？”

text_en: The Lord said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, and say, ‘Shall I indeed bear a child, now that I am old? ’
text_cn: 上主对亚巴郎说：“撒辣为什么笑？且说：像我这样老，真的还能生育？

text_en: Is anything too wonderful for the Lord ? At the set time I will return to you, in due season, and Sarah shall have a son. ”
text_cn: 为上主岂有难事？明年这时，我必要回到你这里，那时撒辣必有一个儿子。”

text_en: But Sarah denied, saying, “I did not laugh”; for she was afraid. He said, “Oh yes, you did laugh. ”
text_cn: 撒辣害怕了，否认说：“我没有笑。”但是那位说：“不，你实在笑了。”

text_en: Then the men set out from there, and they looked toward Sodom; and Abraham went with them to set them on their way.
text_cn: 后来那三人由那里起身，望着索多玛前行；亚巴郎送他们，也一同前行。

text_en: The Lord said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do,
text_cn: 上主说：“我要作的事，岂能瞒着亚巴郎？

text_en: seeing that Abraham shall become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
text_cn: 因为他要成为一强大而又兴盛的民族，地上所有的民族，都要因他蒙受祝福；

text_en: No, for I have chosen him, that he may charge his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing righteousness and justice; so that the Lord may bring about for Abraham what he has promised him. ”
text_cn: 何况我拣选了他，是要他训令自己的子孙和未来的家族，保持上主的正道，实行公义正道，好使上主能实现他对亚巴郎所许的事。”

text_en: Then the Lord said, “How great is the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah and how very grave their sin!
text_cn: 上主于是说：“控告索多玛和哈摩辣的声音实在很大，他们的罪恶实在深重！

text_en: I must go down and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry that has come to me; and if not, I will know. ”
text_cn: 我要下去看看，愿意知道：是否他们所行的全如达到我前的呼声一样。”

text_en: So the men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, while Abraham remained standing before the Lord .
text_cn: 三人中有二人转身向索多玛走去；亚巴郎却仍立在上主面前。

text_en: Then Abraham came near and said, “Will you indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
text_cn: 亚巴郎近前来说：“你真要将义人同恶人一起消灭吗？

text_en: Suppose there are fifty righteous within the city; will you then sweep away the place and not forgive it for the fifty righteous who are in it?
text_cn: 假如城中有五十个义人，你还要消灭吗？不为其中的那五十个义人，赦免那地方吗？

text_en: Far be it from you to do such a thing, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous fare as the wicked! Far be that from you! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do what is just? ”
text_cn: 你决不能如此行事，将义人同恶人一并诛灭；将义人如恶人一样看待，你决不能！审判全地的主，岂能不行公义？”

text_en: And the Lord said, “If I find at Sodom fifty righteous in the city, I will forgive the whole place for their sake. ”
text_cn: 上主答说：“假如我在索多玛城中找出了五十个义人，为了他们我要赦免整个地方。”

text_en: Abraham answered, “Let me take it upon myself to speak to the Lord, I who am but dust and ashes.
text_cn: 亚巴郎接着说：

text_en: Suppose five of the fifty righteous are lacking? Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five? ” And he said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there. ”
text_cn: “我虽只是尘埃灰土，胆敢再对我主说：假如五十个义人中少了五个怎样？你就为了少五个而毁灭全城吗？”他答说：“假如我在那里找到四十五个，我不毁灭。”

text_en: Again he spoke to him, “Suppose forty are found there. ” He answered, “For the sake of forty I will not do it. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎再向他进言说：“假如在那里找到四十个怎样？”他答说：“为了这四十个我也不做这事。”

text_en: Then he said, “Oh do not let the Lord be angry if I speak. Suppose thirty are found there. ” He answered, “I will not do it, if I find thirty there. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：“求我主且勿动怒，容我再进一言：假如在那里找到三十个怎样？”他答说：“假如在那里我找到三十个，我也不做这事。”

text_en: He said, “Let me take it upon myself to speak to the Lord. Suppose twenty are found there. ” He answered, “For the sake of twenty I will not destroy it. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：“我再放胆对我主进一言：假如在那里找到二十个怎样？”他答说：“为了这二十个，我也不毁灭。”

text_en: Then he said, “Oh do not let the Lord be angry if I speak just once more. Suppose ten are found there. ” He answered, “For the sake of ten I will not destroy it. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：“求我主且勿动怒，容我最后一次进言：假如在那里找到十个怎样？”他答说：“为了这十个我也不毁灭。”

text_en: And the Lord went his way, when he had finished speaking to Abraham; and Abraham returned to his place.
text_cn: 上主向亚巴郎说完话就走了；亚巴郎也回家去了。
